data.narrative:
GenFab Co is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Matt Parlmer that has raised $510K to date. The robotics and manufacturing sector includes 1 public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private peers, including established players such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics.

Given the early stage and absence of sufficient narrow peer data, only one valuation method proved applicable. Stage-progression analysis uses the company's $510K total raised as a value proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement in this sector, yielding an implied valuation of $1.3M. The peer-median method was not applied due to insufficient comparable data; while 8 robotics and manufacturing peers exist in the dataset, none met the filters for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier clustering, which would have required at least 3 datapoints to be statistically meaningful.

The triangulated analysis, constrained to a single method, supports a valuation range of $1.1M (low) to $1.5M (high), centered on a median of $1.3M. Key uncertainties include the absence of near-peer financial or growth metrics and limited visibility into GenFab's technical differentiation or market traction relative to the broader peer set. A more robust valuation would benefit from direct revenue or customer data and a tighter peer cohort within the robotics manufacturing subsector.
